narrative: Unconfirmed reports of a Saudi oil tanker halted in the Strait of Hormuz introduce a geopolitical risk premium as WTI firms to $86.2; gold higher +0.50% near $4,500 and equities -0.33%. The dollar retreats as DXY -0.29% on dovish Bessent comments, while USD/JPY consolidates at 159.74 despite a 266bp SOFR-TONA carry advantage; VIX 14.9. USD/JPY options show a strong put skew with RR at -1.74 (Saxo, 1M) as hedging for a carry unwind intensifies. Watch the RBNZ rate decision at 02:00 UTC on September 2.
